items.title: Detour Dog Caught Running DNS-Powered Malware Factory for Strela Stealer
items.description: A threat actor named Detour Dog has been outed as powering campaigns distributing an information stealer known as Strela Stealer. That's according to findings from Infoblox, which found the threat actor to maintain control of domains hosting the first stage of the stealer, a backdoor called StarFish.
